description: This file defines the CommitMessageProvider class which manages commit message generation by coordinating between VSCode and JetBrains adapters, registering commands, and handling workspace paths.

classes.name: CommitMessageProvider
classes.description: Manages commit message generation, command registration, and adapter coordination for VSCode and JetBrains environments.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Registers commands to generate commit messages for VSCode and JetBrains.

methods.name: handleVSCodeCommand
methods.description: Converts VSCode request to a generic commit message request and invokes the VSCode adapter.

methods.name: handleJetBrainsCommand
methods.description: Creates a request from JetBrains command args and invokes the JetBrains adapter.

methods.name: determineWorkspacePath
methods.description: Determines the workspace path from a URI or current workspace.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources and disposes adapters.
